title: 2013: Reporting, Zest, HTTP sessions, and SAML
description: Student Hall of Fame entries for 2013 Summer GSoC: BIRT Reporting, Zest enhancements, HTTP Session Handling, and SAML 2.0 support

chapters.title: BIRT Reporting
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Rauf Butt for BIRT Reporting (2013 Summer GSoC). The commit "BIRT Reporting with XML data source and Scripting - GSoC 2013 by Rauf Butt" is dated 2013-10-09.

chapters.title: Zest enhancements
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Alessandro Secco for Zest enhancements (2013 Summer GSoC). Zest work appears as "ZestLoopFile UI + SurroundWith + get/add to Fuzzer Files" (2013-08-12).

chapters.title: HTTP Session Handling
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Cosmin Stefan for Enhanced HTTP Session Handling (2013 Summer GSoC). The earliest commit titled "Initial version of http sessions handling." is dated 2012-08-03.

chapters.title: SAML 2.0 support
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists Pulasthi Mahawithana for SAML 2.0 support (2013 Summer GSoC). The commit "Initial version of http sessions handling." is dated 2012-08-03, and "Added SAML extension's initial code for alpha release" is dated 2013-09-05.
